title: Design: New Customer without AP/AR access has no credit fields
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A user who can create customers but has no AP/AR Data access adds a customer, and you compare it with the design.
  • You are signed in as {User-A}, working in {Location-A}, and the role of {User-A} can create customers but does not have View and Manage AP/AR Data.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-39 No AP and {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p5-05-new-customer-without-view-and-manage-ap-ar-data.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the window has no Credit Terms and no Credit Limit; the Sales Representative field follows State/Province and Country directly, with no gap left (as in ct-p5-05-new-customer-without-view-and-manage-ap-ar-data.png).
  • Step 2: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-N1: “If the user does not have the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' setting, New Customer and Edit Customer show neither Credit Terms nor Credit Limit (as Edit Customer today).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "5 New Customer" ("New Customer without View and Manage AP/AR Data").
